prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed according to the study plan in the 1st and 2nd semesters.
Recommended: Technical Mechanics 3: This course builds systematically on the basic lecture Technical Mechanics 3.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can name and classify vibration forms.
They create models of simple technical systems and can then independently derive and solve the dynamic equations of machines.

syllabus_topics: Discrete systems with one degree of freedom
Discrete systems with multiple degrees of freedom
assessment_rules: The allocation of credit points occurs if the module final examination is passed. In the exam, students should be able to set up and solve the equations of simple technical systems.
